Author: Christian Marangi <ansuelsmth@gmail.com>

    crypto: eip93 - Add Inside Secure SafeXcel EIP-93 crypto engine support
    
    Add support for the Inside Secure SafeXcel EIP-93 Crypto Engine used on
    Mediatek MT7621 SoC and new Airoha SoC.
    
    EIP-93 IP supports AES/DES/3DES ciphers in ECB/CBC and CTR modes as well as
    authenc(HMAC(x), cipher(y)) using HMAC MD5, SHA1, SHA224 and SHA256.
bic_trace_step.reason: In the function `eip93_unregister_algs`, the loop iterates using the variable `j` from `0` to `i`. However, in the `EIP93_ALG_TYPE_HASH` case on line 91, it incorrectly uses the function parameter `i` instead of the loop iterator `j` to index the array: `crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[i]->alg.ahash);`. This causes the same algorithm at index `i` to be unregistered multiple times (or out-of-bounds access if `i` is equal to the array size), while the algorithm at index `j` is not unregistered.
